title: Use glow-only focus feedback on all linked panels
context: Linked panels already provide sufficient visible keyboard feedback through their static glow, opaque surface, border, and amber shadow. The additional outline is redundant on both standard and slanted variants.

tasks.title: Remove linked-panel focus outlines
acceptance_criteria: Keyboard-focused standard and slanted linked panels have no additional outline
Both variants retain visible static glow and high-contrast focused surface feedback
The unused global blue-soft CSS variable is removed
End-to-end coverage and design documentation describe the shared glow-only focus treatment
